Committee: State Government
Sponsor: Holmes
Analyst: Vee Mosely
Date: 04/13/2021
FISCAL NOTE
House Bill 242 as introduced amends the Alabama Memorial Preservation Act to revise the amount of fine that may be levied for violation of the act from $25,000 per violation, currently, to $10,000 per day that the violation continues.
Chris Pringle, Chair
State Government
